messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: simsem problems
parts:
Hi all,

I found out that some examples in simsem does not work with the current version of lavaan on CRAN. Please use the development version of lavaan instead. See how to install it in the following page:

http://lavaan.ugent.be/development.html

I apologize for not checking it with the CRAN version. Please let me know if you have found any other problems.

Best,
Sunthud

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: simsem problems
parts:
Hi all,

It is a bug that I did not find in my computer previously. After I reinstalled R, I found the problems, which is very weird. The problem should be fixed in version 0.5-14 downloadable from the following link:

https://github.com/simsem/simsem/tree/master/builds

Best,
Sunthud
